mentions.note: 44th National 10 miles; 7th Hornchurch 10 km; 4th Metropolitan 20 km; 9th Southern Area 20 miles; 2nd Belgrave and Middlesex championships; 5th Traders 7 miles; 2nd Police Championships Barking to Southend; 9th Mercury 20 miles; 2nd Southern Track 10 km; absent from National 35 km; won Gloucester 7 miles; 5th National 50 km; 6th Southern 20 km; won G.L.C. 3 km; 7th London Postal Region 10 km
